VerbatimExtractedFact.description:
Schema for verbatim extraction mode.

Omits 'what' entirely — the original chunk text is used as fact_text in code.
The LLM only extracts metadata: entities, temporal info, location, people.

who.description: People involved with relationships. 'N/A' if general.
who.title: Who

fact_type.description: 'world' = objective/external facts. 'assistant' = first-person actions, experiences, or observations by the speaker.
fact_type.title: Fact Type

entities.description: People, places, concepts - plain strings, e.g. ["Alice", "Kubernetes"]
entities.title: Entities

VerbatimExtractedFact.title: VerbatimExtractedFact

description: Response for verbatim extraction mode (one entry per chunk, no fact text).

facts.description: List of metadata entries (one per chunk)
facts.title: Facts

title: VerbatimFactExtractionResponse
